purpose: C17 historical-definition guard. Lists every file OUTSIDE sql/current/ that is known and reviewed to CREATE an object managed by sql/current/, with the exact count per object. These are historical migrations: evidence of how production got here, not current definitions, and never to be re-applied over sql/current/. A new file, or an additional CREATE of a canonical object, fails CI until it is reviewed and added here. The guard does not validate historical SQL correctness or parity.
